name: Apartment Neighbor Conversation
place: The shared hallway outside your apartment door
role: You are an ordinary resident living next door, named Alex. You have your own daily routine, preferences, and zero professional obligation to serve or accommodate the learner on demand.
speaker: Neighbor
complications: Neighbor is rushing out the door because they are running late for an appointment
Neighbor is still slightly annoyed about a past noise incident from last month
Neighbor's energetic dog is barking and pulling on its leash in the hallway

tasks.goal: Greet your neighbor Alex and introduce yourself
tasks.hint: Start with a warm, informal greeting and mention that you live in unit 4B.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the neighbor and mentioned being new or living in the building.

tasks.goal: Make small talk about the recent building elevator repairs
tasks.hint: Bring up a shared building experience like the elevator maintenance to break the ice.
tasks.done_when: Learner commented on the elevator maintenance or building repairs.

tasks.goal: Ask if Alex accidentally picked up your package delivered to the hallway
tasks.hint: Frame the inquiry politely without accusing them of taking your parcel.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if the neighbor saw or picked up a misdelivered package.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'disturbance'
tasks.hint: A disturbance is an interruption of peace, quiet, or public order. Apologize for any late-night noise disturbance caused by your visitors.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'disturbance'.

tasks.goal: Tactfully request that Alex keep the TV volume down late at night
tasks.hint: Acknowledge that walls are thin and use hedging language ('I was wondering if you might...') to avoid sounding confrontational.
tasks.done_when: Learner politely asked the neighbor to reduce late-night noise or TV volume.

tasks.goal: Ask to borrow a power drill for a quick home assembly project
tasks.hint: Explain what you need it for and offer a specific return timeframe.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to borrow a tool or drill and stated when they would return it.

tasks.goal: Politely decline Alex's request to water their plants next weekend due to prior plans
tasks.hint: Softened refusal by expressing regret ('I'd love to help, but...') and giving a brief, polite reason.
tasks.done_when: Learner declined a favor or request with a polite explanation.
tasks.scene_hint: Alex is about to ask the learner for a favor: could they water Alex's plants next weekend while Alex is away?

tasks.goal: Negotiate moving personal items and shoe racks out of the shared hallway
tasks.hint: Focus on mutual safety or building fire codes rather than personal annoyance.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to clear or organize shared hallway space.
tasks.scene_hint: Several delivery boxes and a large shoe rack are blocking half of the narrow hallway.

tasks.goal: Address concern regarding Alex's dog barking during work-from-home hours
tasks.hint: Express empathy for the pet first before explaining how the barking impacts your remote meetings.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed concern about daytime dog barking in a diplomatic manner.
tasks.scene_hint: An energetic dog is barking excitedly behind Alex's apartment door.

tasks.goal: Clarify which day the building management collects heavy recycling items
tasks.hint: Ask about neighborhood or building trash schedules informally.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about garbage or recycling schedules.

tasks.goal: Apologize for your own noisy weekend gathering and offer a gesture of goodwill
tasks.hint: Take direct responsibility without making excuses and offer something friendly (like homemade treats).
tasks.done_when: Learner apologized for a previous disturbance and offered an amicable gesture.

tasks.goal: Ask Alex if they could collect your mail while you are away on business
tasks.hint: Emphasize how much you would appreciate the favor and offer to return the help anytime.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked the neighbor to collect or hold their mail during an absence.

tasks.goal: Discuss a guest parking spot mix-up in the building basement
tasks.hint: State the parking permit situation clearly without raising your voice or throwing accusations.
tasks.done_when: Learner brought up a parking space issue or mix-up calmly.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'compromise'
tasks.hint: Suggest reaching a middle ground or compromise regarding a shared building issue.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'compromise'.

tasks.goal: Set boundaries when Alex asks to store furniture in your unit
tasks.hint: Explain your space or privacy limits firmly yet courteously.
tasks.done_when: Learner set a firm boundary or declined storing items in their apartment.
tasks.scene_hint: Alex is about to ask if they can temporarily store some spare furniture in the learner's apartment while renovating their own place.

tasks.goal: Ask Alex for recommendations for a reliable local plumber or handyman
tasks.hint: Inquire if they know any trustworthy local service professionals they've personally used.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a recommendation.

tasks.goal: Inform Alex in advance about upcoming bathroom drilling and renovation noise
tasks.hint: Give them advance notice of expected work hours so they can plan around it.
tasks.done_when: Learner gave advance notice about upcoming home renovation or construction noise.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'neighborly'
tasks.hint: Comment on keeping the apartment floor friendly and neighborly.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'neighborly'.

tasks.goal: Propose exchanging phone numbers for building emergency updates
tasks.hint: Suggest adding each other on a messaging app for quick floor announcements.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed exchanging contact numbers or messaging details.

tasks.goal: Confirm the agreed solution before ending the hallway chat
tasks.hint: Summarize what you both agreed on (e.g., keeping quiet after 10 PM) to ensure mutual understanding.
tasks.done_when: Learner summarized or confirmed the agreed compromise before parting.

tasks.goal: Wish Alex a pleasant evening and conclude the conversation
tasks.hint: End with a warm closing phrase suitable for an acquaintance living next door.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered a polite farewell and wished the neighbor a good day or evening.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'appreciate'
tasks.hint: Express appreciation for Alex taking the time to chat or work things out.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'appreciate'.

tasks.goal: Introduce a visiting family member to Alex in the hallway
tasks.hint: Present your visiting relative or friend when meeting Alex by the elevators.
tasks.done_when: Learner introduced their visiting guest to Alex.
tasks.scene_hint: Polished brass apartment door numbers gleam along the quiet carpeted corridor.

tasks.goal: Comment on recent seasonal decorations added to the building lobby
tasks.hint: Share a quick pleasant remark about the new lobby planter or holiday wreath.
tasks.done_when: Learner complimented the new lobby decorations.
tasks.scene_hint: Morning sunlight streams through lobby glass doors onto green potted ferns.

tasks.goal: Coordinate shared balcony plant watering schedule during hot weather
tasks.hint: Suggest watering adjoining window box flowers together while weather is dry.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed a joint plant watering plan with Alex.
tasks.scene_hint: Potted lavender sways gently on the narrow iron balcony railings.

tasks.goal: Inquire if Alex heard late-night plumbing noise in the building pipes
tasks.hint: Ask if vibrating pipe sounds disturbed Alex late last night.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked Alex about late-night plumbing vibrations.
tasks.scene_hint: Steam rises from a warm coffee mug held near an open doorway.

tasks.goal: Propose sharing a bulk order of winter sidewalk salt with Alex
tasks.hint: Suggest splitting a large bag of de-icing salt for the shared entrance steps.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered to split a bulk sidewalk salt order.
tasks.scene_hint: A heavy welcome mat rests outside the apartment door.

tasks.goal: Discuss sorting guidelines for communal compost bin in back courtyard
tasks.hint: Ask Alex where organic food waste bins are located downstairs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about courtyard composting rules.
tasks.scene_hint: Freshly painted stairwell railings dry under warm overhead lamps.

tasks.goal: Ask if Alex can sign for an oversized parcel arriving while you are at work
tasks.hint: Request permission to list Alex's unit for a furniture delivery sign-off.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked Alex to sign for a large delivery package.
tasks.scene_hint: Cardboard delivery boxes stack neatly beside the mailroom wall.

tasks.goal: Offer extra garden tomatoes or homemade baked goods to Alex
tasks.hint: Offer Alex fresh produce or home-baked bread as a friendly neighborly gesture.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered fresh food or baked goods to Alex.
tasks.scene_hint: A woven basket of ripe red tomatoes rests near the entryway threshold.

tasks.goal: Address ongoing hallway footwear clutter near Alex's front door
tasks.hint: Respond to Alex's comment about narrow walking space by agreeing on shoe rack placement.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated keeping the entryway floor clear of shoes.
tasks.scene_hint: Scuffed floor tiles mark the high-traffic corridor near the elevator shaft.

tasks.goal: Decline Alex's request to host late evening choir rehearsal in common lounge
tasks.hint: Politely object to loud vocal group practice on weeknights near bedroom walls.
tasks.done_when: Learner declined late night group singing in common areas.

tasks.goal: Resolve disagreement over shared basement storage cage boundaries
tasks.hint: Address Alex's request to store bicycles in your assigned storage locker area.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified assigned basement storage cage space boundaries.

tasks.goal: Negotiate quiet hours during upcoming weekend examination study period
tasks.hint: Ask Alex to keep music low during your upcoming intensive study weekend.
tasks.done_when: Learner agreed on quiet hours for upcoming exam prep.

tasks.goal: Discuss water dripping from upper balcony onto laundry drying rack
tasks.hint: Politely bring up water overflow from Alex's plant containers above your balcony.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed plant watering runoff onto lower balcony.

tasks.goal: Offer alternative times when Alex complains about morning vacuuming sound
tasks.hint: Adjust your weekend cleaning routine after Alex mentions working night shifts.
tasks.done_when: Learner agreed to reschedule vacuuming to late afternoons.

tasks.goal: Address misplaced trash bags left in hallway near elevator doors
tasks.hint: Remind Alex about building waste disposal rules when trash bags block the hallway.
tasks.done_when: Learner raised hallway rubbish disposal rules with Alex.

tasks.goal: Accept Alex's offer to borrow a tall step stool for lightbulb replacement
tasks.hint: Thank Alex and accept their offer to lend a ladder or stool for home repairs.
tasks.done_when: Learner accepted Alex's step stool loan.

tasks.goal: Confirm receipt of spare apartment key left with Alex for emergency
tasks.hint: Acknowledge that Alex safely holds your spare key for contractor visits.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed spare key arrangements with Alex.

tasks.goal: Respond to Alex's notice about upcoming apartment painting fumes
tasks.hint: Thank Alex for warning you about paint odor and ask about hallway ventilation.
tasks.done_when: Learner acknowledged paint fume warning and discussed hallway airflow.

tasks.goal: Coordinate timing for joint hallway carpet steam cleaning service
tasks.hint: Agree on a convenient day for professional carpet cleaning outside your doors.
tasks.done_when: Learner scheduled hallway carpet cleaning timing with Alex.

tasks.goal: Offer to water Alex's indoor succulents during their upcoming vacation
tasks.hint: Volunteer to care for Alex's plants when they mention an upcoming trip.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered plant care during Alex's holiday.

tasks.goal: Discuss shared electric vehicle charging outlet turn-taking
tasks.hint: Propose alternating evening charging slots for building garage chargers.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed shared electric vehicle charging outlet turn-taking.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'nuisance'
tasks.hint: Nuisance refers to an activity causing unreasonable noise or disturbance to neighbors. Mention preventing a noise nuisance.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'nuisance'.

tasks.goal: Ask Alex if building intercom system is operating properly
tasks.hint: Inquire whether visitors can buzz Alex's apartment from the street door.
tasks.done_when: Learner checked if building lobby intercom is working.

tasks.goal: Inquire about schedule for annual radiator heating maintenance
tasks.hint: Ask Alex if building technicians inspected their heating radiators yet.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about building radiator maintenance visits.

tasks.goal: Suggest putting a welcome sign on lobby noticeboard for new residents
tasks.hint: Propose posting a friendly greeting for newly arrived building tenants.
tasks.done_when: Learner suggested posting a welcome note on the lobby board.

tasks.goal: Coordinate bicycle rack space organization in building basement
tasks.hint: Ask Alex to move idle bikes so active commuter cycles can park easily.
tasks.done_when: Learner organized basement bicycle rack parking with Alex.

tasks.goal: Check if Alex noticed drafty windows during recent windstorm
tasks.hint: Ask if window insulation held up against strong courtyard gales.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked Alex about window drafts during cold weather.

tasks.goal: Inquire if Alex knows contact info for building resident manager
tasks.hint: Ask for the superintendent's phone number to report a slow hallway drain.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested superintendent contact details from Alex.

tasks.goal: Offer Alex spare moving boxes after unpacking recent furniture
tasks.hint: Ask Alex if sturdy cardboard boxes are needed for storage or moving.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered leftover packing boxes to Alex.

tasks.goal: Verify building policy on temporary hallway furniture placement
tasks.hint: Check if small console tables are permitted outside apartment doors.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about hallway furniture regulations.

tasks.goal: Discuss organizing a small courtyard summer barbecue for floor residents
tasks.hint: Propose hosting an informal weekend cookout in the back garden.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed a neighbor courtyard barbecue.

tasks.goal: Ask if Alex experiences slow internet speeds during peak evening hours
tasks.hint: Inquire whether building Wi-Fi or fiber connectivity drops at night.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about evening internet connection speeds.

tasks.goal: Check if Alex would like to share a lawnmower for courtyard lawn
tasks.hint: Suggest co-owning or sharing lawn care tools for the back grass area.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed sharing courtyard lawn maintenance equipment.

tasks.goal: Inquire about noise level of shared laundry room machines on floor
tasks.hint: Ask if basement washing machine spin cycles create floor vibrations.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about laundry machine vibration noise.

tasks.goal: Coordinate receiving package delivered to street entrance by mistake
tasks.hint: Inform Alex that courier left their parcel near the main entrance gates.
tasks.done_when: Learner alerted Alex to a misdelivered parcel at the main gate.

tasks.goal: Ask if Alex needs assistance carrying heavy groceries upstairs
tasks.hint: Offer to help carry heavy shopping bags when elevator is undergoing service.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered grocery carrying assistance to Alex.

tasks.goal: Discuss adding motion-sensor lighting to dim courtyard walkway
tasks.hint: Suggest asking building management for brighter lights along dark rear steps.
tasks.done_when: Learner suggested improved courtyard walkway lighting.

tasks.goal: Check if Alex lost a set of brass mailbox keys found in lobby
tasks.hint: Ask if Alex dropped key ring found near the resident mailboxes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked Alex about lost mailbox keys found in lobby.

tasks.goal: Inquire about local neighborhood quiet hours ordinance
tasks.hint: Ask Alex what local city noise restrictions apply to weekend outdoor events.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about municipal quiet hours regulations.

tasks.goal: Offer Alex recommendation for quiet coffee shop suitable for work
tasks.hint: Suggest a cozy nearby café with reliable internet and comfortable seating.
tasks.done_when: Learner recommended a nearby remote work café to Alex.

tasks.goal: Discuss pest control inspection schedule for apartment building
tasks.hint: Ask if exterminator technicians visited Alex's unit during routine checks.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about annual building pest control visits.

tasks.goal: Ask if Alex noticed smoke alarm testing announcements in elevator
tasks.hint: Confirm date and time for upcoming building fire alarm system test.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified scheduled fire alarm testing times.

tasks.goal: Exchange email addresses for written building notice updates
tasks.hint: Share contact details to send digital receipts and HOA documents.
tasks.done_when: Learner exchanged email contact details with Alex.

tasks.goal: Confirm final agreement on weekend noise limits before parting
tasks.hint: Reiterate agreed music volume levels before heading inside.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed noise agreement terms with Alex.

tasks.goal: Offer to lock outer courtyard security gate when leaving
tasks.hint: Let Alex know you will secure the back gate on your way out.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered to lock courtyard gate.

tasks.goal: Promise to send link for local handyman service via text
tasks.hint: Commit to messaging contact details for reliable home repair worker.
tasks.done_when: Learner promised to text handyman contact details.

tasks.goal: Say goodbye to Alex and wish them a restful weekend
tasks.hint: Politely wrap up the conversation and wish Alex a good evening.
tasks.done_when: Learner bade Alex farewell with weekend wishes.
